item.title: Hegseth defends Trump Iran strikes, demands media ‘get it right’
item.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth said U.S. operations against Iran have targeted military infrastructure and naval assets, describing the campaign as focused on defined objectives, during a Cabinet meeting.

item.title: Drone food delivery launches in New Jersey
item.summary: Grubhub launches a drone delivery pilot in New Jersey, testing faster food service with no added cost for eligible customers within a limited range.

item.title: Brother, sister indicted in alleged IED plot at Florida base tied to Iran war; one suspect in China
item.summary: FBI Tampa has obtained indictments of a brother and sister in connection with a possible explosive device found at MacDill Air Force Base. The brother is in China.

item.title: GOP disruptor counters Biden's student loan bailouts with plan to shift costs away from taxpayers
item.summary: Michael Carbonara, a Republican congressional candidate in Florida, is pitching an idea to reduce the student loan debt crisis without passing the buck to American taxpayers.

item.title: Trump reveals ‘present’ from Iran as oil tankers move through Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Trump claims oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz signal real talks, as Steve Witkoff reports positive signs in U.S.-Iran backchannel negotiations.

item.title: Watchdog warns legal powerhouse has made far-left advocacy their 'dominant focus' over the last decade
item.summary: Trump-aligned watchdog group, America First Legal, says a decade of American Bar Association amicus briefs shows the powerful legal group pushed liberal outcomes 80% of the time it weighed in.

item.title: Illegal immigrant allegedly stalks, hunts teenager through local park in armed attack: police
item.summary: Vidal Jimenez, an illegal immigrant, allegedly chased a Florida teen through a park with a knife, and is facing felony charges enhanced by his immigration status.

item.title: Trump pressures GOP to scrap filibuster, says 'desperate' Schumer 'will make a deal'
item.summary: President Donald Trump is pressuring the Senate GOP to scrap the filibuster in order to ram their priorities through the legislative chamber.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney thanks military service members as she reveals brother is deployed
item.summary: Sydney Sweeney shared a photo of her deployed brother Trent, a U.S. Air Force staff sergeant, and thanked all service members stationed overseas.

item.title: Zelenskyy claims US tied Ukraine security guarantees to giving up Donbas, White House denies
item.summary: Zelenskyy claimed U.S. security guarantees for Ukraine are tied to ceding Donbas to Russia, but the White House says those claims are false.
